title: Commander Collection: Black: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Come now, dear brother. If you wanted rules, you should have called it a *game*, not a *war*." —Gisa, to Geralf
Her writhing, boneless movements are unsettling to humans, but hypnotic to her serpent brood.
A whisper of authority rises over a cacophony of grinding machines.
"Death is a small price to pay for immortality." —Baron Sengir
"I am greater than rain and nourishment. I am glistening oil and perfection." —Yawgmoth
Deep within the forsaken cavern, a new shadow emerged to devour the light.
"It's a bit much, I know, but it reminds my visitors who really holds the power here." —Davriel Cane
